name: CLUB NO-NO PROUDLY PRESENTS JEFF23 FROM SPIRAL TRIBE & SNORRE MAGNAR SOLBERG
description:
CLUB NO-NO PROUDLY PRESENTS JEFF23 FROM SPIRAL TRIBE & SNORRE MAGNAR
SOLBERG 08.08.2026 @ KAFE HÆRVERK. FIRST TIME EVER ONE OF THE SPIRAL
TRIBE MEMBERS PLAYS IN NORWAY!

JEFF23 (AKA DJ TAL, AKA TEKNIKAL SINNER, AKA ASIPU THE THERAPIST) HAS
BEEN A DJ FOR NEARLY 40 YEARS, AN ORIGINAL MEMBER OF SPIRAL TRIBE
SOUND SYSTEM SINCE 1991, AND IS STILL KEEPING IT REAL AND PUSHING THE
SOUND OF THE FUTURE WITH HIS OWN UNIQUE TAKE ON CONTEMPORARY SOUNDS
AND RIDDIMS <<<23>>>

SNORRE MAGNAR SOLBERG IS A MOUNTAIN GOAT FROM BERGEN BUT IS SOMETIMES
SEEN AND HEARD OUTSIDE OF HIS HABITAT AT KAFE HÆRVERK IN OSLO WHERE HE
CONTINUES TO PUSH THE BOUNDARIES OF ELEKTRONIK TEKNO MUZAK AND BEYOND!
